comment: sounds.c temple_priest_sound() 161-162: a debug Valkyrie with monpolycontrol wishes for a wand of polymorph, level-teleports to Minetown, maps it and ^T-teleports beside the temple altar. Zapping the priestess angers her (Tyr smites the hero; wizard mode declines each death) and she resists; a second zap lets the hero turn her into a newt, which keeps ispriest. The hero ^T-teleports to the up stairs outside the temple, turns on debug_mongen and rests: dosounds() picks the temple, and because the newt is speechless (MS_SILENT <= MS_ANIMAL) the loop skips each '*' message (162) before 'You hear an animal carcass being offered in sacrifice.' The last ESC dismisses the --More--.
